title: How Much Does a Website Cost in Des Moines? A 2026 Guide for Local Businesses
excerpt: Why Des Moines web design quotes range from $900 to $12,000, what a local business actually needs to pay for, and what a site costs when the price is published: $2,800 or $5,800 flat.
metaTitle: Website Cost in Des Moines (2026 Guide) | Axeon Studio
metaDescription: What a small-business website costs in Des Moines in 2026, why quotes vary so much, and our flat prices: $2,800 and $5,800. Six questions to ask first.

faqItems.question: How much does a small business website cost in Des Moines?
faqItems.answer: Most professional custom builds in 2026 land between $3,000 and $15,000 depending on who builds it and what is included. Axeon Studio publishes two flat prices: the Core Web Build at $2,800 and AxeonCORE at $5,800, both one-time build prices with full ownership of the site.

faqItems.question: Why do web design quotes vary so much?
faqItems.answer: Four things drive the number: who is building it (DIY, freelancer, or agency), whether the design is a template or custom, whether the quote covers pages only or the lead systems behind them, and how the builder bills (hourly, proposal, or flat rate).

faqItems.question: Do I own my website when it is finished?
faqItems.answer: With Axeon Studio, yes. You own 100 percent of the site, the code, and the design files. Ask any builder this question before you sign; if the answer is anything other than yes, you are renting.

faqItems.question: What is the difference between the Core Web Build and AxeonCORE?
faqItems.answer: Core Web Build ($2,800) is up to four custom, mobile-first pages with SEO built in and instant lead alerts. AxeonCORE ($5,800) adds a Custom CRM Pipeline, AI chat and online scheduling, automated text and email follow-up, a pre-qualifying intake form, and a half-day on-site video and photo shoot.

sources.claim: Most professional small-business website builds in 2026 land between $3,000 and $15,000; freelancer builds for a basic 5-8 page site run roughly $2,500-$7,000 and agency builds $5,000-$15,000.
